What if a tiny piece of metal could turn an ordinary Glock into a fully automatic machine gun? Known as a Glock switch, this illegal conversion device allows a pistol to fire multiple rounds with a single pull of the trigger. These modifications are becoming a serious concern for American law enforcement, turning everyday handguns into dangerous automatic weapons!

title: This TINY Device Turns a Glock Into a MACHINE GUN!
